# Stephen McCarthy

> Professional website of Stephen McCarthy, a physician assistant in Allentown, Pennsylvania. His work covers psychiatric care, clinical AI evaluation, and writing about evidence and psychiatric diagnosis.

## Clinical AI evaluation

- [Consulting](https://www.stephenmccarthypa.com/consulting): Evaluation services and the scope of a private pilot.
- [PsychWorkflowBench](https://www.stephenmccarthypa.com/psychworkflowbench): Six synthetic cases and 71 scoring questions for psychiatric documentation.
- [Sample failure map](https://www.stephenmccarthypa.com/psychworkflowbench/sample.html): A demonstration with deliberately constructed notes. The case references and AI judgments await clinician confirmation.
- [Private case design](https://www.stephenmccarthypa.com/case-factory): How cases can be tailored to a documentation workflow.
